title: usenet-ipfs-mail: Email read path
description:
Implement JMAP Email read operations: Email object type mapping ArticleRootNode→Email (id=CID, blobId, mailboxIds, keywords, from, subject, date, size), Email/get (fetch from IPFS), Email/query (query overview store), and Blob/get (stream raw article bytes by CID).

Why: reading articles is the core use case; Blob/get is required so clients can render full message bodies.

How to apply: Email write and user-state sub-epics build on the Email object type defined here.
